name: Aproumu Aizi
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Ahate, Tamala Louise 2018 (study of Aproumu Aizi cited by Glottolog); Marchese, Lynell and Ann Hook 1983 (on Aizi).
earlier_scan.note: Neither work locatable online (Ivorian thesis; 1983 paper not digitized); could not verify whether they state stress, but they are the only descriptive sources named.

sources.citation: Vogler, Pierre. 2024. La classification de l'aizi (Côte d'Ivoire, groupe kru, Niger-Congo). Unpublished ms., HAL hal-04627162, 9 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. Comparative-classificatory paper restricted explicitly to the Tiégba (Tiagba, [ahi], Kru) variety ('On se limitera ici au parler de Tiégba'); Apro is not treated; no accent/stress statement anywhere.

sources.citation: Boone, Douglas, Silué Lamine & MaryAnne Augustin. 2002. L'utilisation du français et de l'adioukrou par les Aïzi. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2002-047. 10 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic survey; sec. 2.3 identifies apro (tchavamrin) as the Kwa-type Aizi language spoken at Attoutou-A, Allaba, Taboth, Bapo, Koko, Téfrédji; no phonology; bibliography names Hérault 1971 and Marchese & Hook 1982.
Segment inventory only; no tone or stress information; underlying source describes Tiagba Aizi, not Apro.
Consonant/vowel charts copied from PHOIBLE 205 (i.e. from the Tiagba description); nothing on tone or stress.

sources.citation: Marchese, Lynell & Ann Hook. 1983. Enquête dialectale en pays aïzi. In G. Hérault (ed.), Atlas des langues kwa de Côte d'Ivoire, tome 1, 173-179. Abidjan: ILA / Paris: ACCT.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: First-hand SIL survey distinguishing apro from lélé/mobu; may include phonological notes (tone levels, syllable types) for apro. HathiTrust uva.x000974809 (search-only); Glottolog/Hammarström library holds.

sources.citation: Ahaté, Tamala Louise. 2018. Le système numéral de l'àprɔ: une analyse morphologique. In W. J. Ekou (ed.), ABILANG 2018 (Actes du colloque, Bouaké), 301-311. Madrid: Vision Libros.
